note: Scripture follows the Open Luganda Contemporary Bible (OLCB 2017, lug_bib — the lug text language_seed.py names), the same verse file earlier Luganda books used. A row is `mined` only when, for every verse it names, a span of at least 25 characters of that OLCB verse appears verbatim (case-insensitive) in the cited block; everything else — Law’s loose, partial, blended or re-personed quotations and unmarked allusions — is `self_rendered` from the English in OLCB’s register. block_index is per chapter (chapter_order).

OLCB’s inner quotation marks are dropped inside Law’s quotations so each block keeps the English straight-quote count; no curly or guillemet quotes are used. Citations use OLCB book names with Arabic numerals (e.g. Matayo 5:22, 1 Abakkolinso 6:19); Law’s [Ver. 7] becomes [Olunyiriri 7].

Character names in Law’s sketches (Flavia, Miranda, Susurrus, Ouranius, Paternus, Eusebia and the rest) are kept as in the English. AI-translated in-session by one translator, chapter by chapter (job #6856); awaiting native review.
